matches.rationale: Both identify the same self-contradiction in the Abstract: ALFAR is claimed to be training-free/plug-and-play while simultaneously requiring fine-tuning. Pred_id 1 explicitly quotes the contradictory statements about training requirements.

GT_id 2 concerns an unusual asymmetric fusion formula in Equation (11) with problematic ratio terms. Pred_id 5 discusses a different issue: weights not summing to 1 in a different fusion formula. These are distinct mathematical problems in the logits fusion mechanism.

Both identify asymmetric GPU allocation in experimental setup. GT_id 3 notes baselines run on fewer GPUs while ALFAR uses 4 GPUs. Pred_id 7 explicitly states ALFAR uses four GPUs while baselines use only one, compromising fairness.

Both concern inflated accuracy numbers in Tables 2 and 3. GT_id 4 states ALFAR numbers are boosted 3-5% beyond baselines. Pred_id 2 identifies a table note claiming gains are 'reduced by 3-5%' which contradicts the actual reported improvements, indicating data integrity issues.

GT_id 5 concerns overstated claims in the Discussion about ALFAR 'fully exploiting' knowledge despite ambiguous/incorrect responses. None of the findings specifically address exaggerated qualitative claims or limitations in the Discussion section's examples.

GT_id 6 concerns missing IRB approvals and privacy safeguards in the Appendix acknowledgments section. None of the findings mention ethical review, IRB, consent procedures, or privacy issues in the acknowledgments.

GT_id 7 concerns fabricated references with future dates (2025+) or imaginary authors/venues, citing reference [12] as example. Pred_id 4 addresses reference [71] misattribution but does not mention future-dated or fabricated references.

GT_id 8 concerns promotional rhetoric in the Introduction ('fully exploits', 'superior performance by large margins'). While findings note various inconsistencies, none specifically flag the Introduction's rhetorical tone as overly promotional or lacking academic nuance.

Both identify contradictory performance numbers for ALFAR in Figure 1 and Introduction. GT_id 9 notes text reports higher numbers than the figure shows. Pred_id 6 identifies missing data and conflicting values between Figure 1 and tables for the same metrics.

Both concern unfair experimental comparisons due to heterogeneous baselines and unnormalized conditions. GT_id 10 notes mixing different model sizes/architectures without proper normalization. Pred_id 7 identifies asymmetric GPU allocation and lack of hyperparameter tuning for baselines.

Both identify contradictory claims about scalability across model sizes. GT_id 11 notes Section 6.3 claims good scaling but 6.5 shows InstructBLIP 13B decline. Pred_id 3 explicitly documents this same contradiction between Section 6.3's scalability claims and the actual Table 8 results.

GT_id 12 concerns missing bias evaluations and safety analyses for knowledge bases in the Experiments section. None of the findings mention bias evaluation, safety analysis, or ethical concerns about knowledge base content.

Both identify misattribution of the GPT-4 technical report in the references. GT_id 13 notes it's incorrectly cited as arXiv preprint rather than OpenAI internal. Pred_id 4 identifies the reverse: it's cited as 'Unpublished internal document' when it's actually a public arXiv preprint.

GT_id 14 concerns selective rhetoric in the Conclusion that omits limitations. While findings identify various inconsistencies, none specifically address the Conclusion's omission of limitations or overly promotional language about 'substantial margins' and 'versatility.'

GT_id 15 concerns selective citation in Related Work that neglects recent training-free fusion techniques. None of the findings address citation bias, missing related work, or selective literature review in that section.

Both concern missing or incomplete attention reallocation formulas in the Method section. GT_id 16 notes formulas don't ensure causal mask preservation. Pred_id 9 identifies that the image-token attention adjustment has no explicit formula and Equation 5 is missing from the sequence.
